User try 2026-08-26: status bar Consolas GPUI text (glyph paint unavailable). stderr: obtaining metrics for font_size=12 @ dpi 96: metrics_for_idx: there is no font with idx=0. Cause: wezterm-font default-features=false features=sys-freetype omitted vendor-jetbrains. Default config family is JetBrains Mono; GDI had no match; built-in TTF bytes were cfg'd out. Fix: features = [sys-freetype, vendor-jetbrains]. cargo check and cargo build green.

User try 2026-08-26: shrink then grow turned the whole shell black (chrome + pane). Cause: each frame uploaded a viewport-sized RenderImage to GPUI's sprite atlas and dropped the previous one. Fix: cached per-glyph sprites + paint_quad cell backgrounds (decision 010).

Sprite cache did not fix shrink-then-grow black pane. GPUI canvas() paint/prepaint are FnOnce and taken on first paint; a resize can repaint without rebuilding the tree, so the pane draws nothing. Replaced canvas with TermScreen Element that paints every frame and resizes the PTY from element bounds.

User screenshot 2026-08-26 182718: after typing a and wiggling the window, a vertical column of D/a at the cursor with the green block cursor at the bottom; dir listing above still visible. Not a black atlas. TermScreen prepaint called LocalPane::resize whenever floor(pane_px/cell) changed. ConPTY ResizePseudoConsole rewrites the screen; oscillating rows smears the cursor cell down the column. wezterm-gui applies live resize too but Win32 resize increments snap to cell size so this is harder to trigger. Fix: first PTY size applies immediately; later grid changes debounce 100ms (decision 011).

User retry 2026-08-26 after decision 011: same D/a column. Debounce is not sufficient. Likely 0×0/sub-cell prepaint bounds clamped to 8×2 (min) then grown to the real grid, which is a huge ConPTY row increase and rains the cursor cell even once. Also possible: trail is paint (colfill on the status bar distinguishes). Follow-up is decision 012.

User after decision 012: new tab colfill=2; dir /a at 84x20 colfill=16; increase width a few pixels colfill=12; decrease width colfill=16; slight increase colfill=7; vertical junk still visible. So the trail is in the cell buffer and a single committed column change is enough. ResizePseudoConsole reflow, not paint smear and not 0×0 clamp. Follow-up: display-only rewrap (decision 013).
